transcript: This is what it's like being on a float at New York City Pride. Truly one of the coolest things I've ever gotten to do, and it's all because of heated rivalry. A few weeks ago, Tyler and I were asked if we were interested in joining the cast of Heated Rivalry, the unauthorized musical parody on their Today takes float at New York City Pride. Obviously, we said yes. Immediately. We got to pick a Shane or Illya Jersey. I went with Illya. Tyler went with Shane, and then we were told to be at 27 of Madison to board our float at 2:15. It was already a vibe. Great outfits, amazing music. Tyler brought glitter spray, which was very popular. I just could not stop smiling. I was so happy. And then it was time to board. Unreal. Now there were two groups, people who were on the float and people who were marching. I could not believe I was actually going to be on this float. I've never been on a float before, but it was immediately a party. Demon and Jay had, like, a hockey throne they got to dance on, and then the rest of us have this little pit area, and the whole thing was, like, moving and shaking, and it was just so fun. When you're on the float, you actually can't, like, throw anything from the float, so we literally just, like, cheering and shouting and singing. Tyler brought a flag with Hudson and Connor. And that was so incredibly popular. Every time he, like, waved it, the entire crowd went nuts. And I'm just so happy we got to be up here with the cast and crew and creative team of heated rivalry the Unauthorized Musical Parody, because I genuinely just love the show so much. I think they're all so brilliant. And it's kind of impossible to really describe or capture this experience because it was so magic. Truly everything I love about New York and pride, the joy and love and community, which is also all the reasons I love heated rivalry. And we also got so lucky cause it was a beautiful day. This was pretty much the mood the entire time. The Pride Parade itself is only about 1.8 miles. You go down fifth, turn on to eighth. The crowd is wild the whole time. Go through the village and past Stonewall before turning up seventh and finishing around 15th Street. The whole thing only lasts about an hour, which it really felt like a lot more. There were so many signs that made me emotional, and I will remember this for the rest of my life. And that was it. That was so much fun. Like, truly once in a lifetime experience. I can't believe that. Thank you, heated rivalry the unauthorized Musical Parody, and today tix for inviting us along. This is the best day. Happy pride.
